zh.title: 瑞士 Edelweiss 航空任命 Wolfensberger 接任執行長
zh.summary: 瑞士休閒航空 Edelweiss Air 宣布，現任 Eurowings 營運長 Edi Wolfensberger 將於 2026 年 10 月 1 日接任執行長，接替掌舵 12 年的 Bernd Bauer。在其領導下，該公司的航點網路從約 40 個擴展至 100 多個航點，員工數也顯著成長。
body: 瑞士休閒航空公司 Edelweiss Air 於 2026 年 7 月 31 日宣布高層人事異動，現任 Eurowings 營運長 Edi Wolfensberger 將於 2026 年 10 月 1 日起接任執行長一職。現任執行長 Bernd Bauer 在領導該航空公司 12 年後準備卸任。

現年 45 歲的 Wolfensberger 為瑞士籍，曾任 Lufthansa Aviation Training Switzerland 總經理。於 2014 年掌舵 Edelweiss 的 Bauer，任內將航點網路由約 40 個擴增至 100 多個，員工數亦從約 500 人增至近 1,700 人。Bauer 亦曾於 2022 年至 2025 年間擔任 Discover Airlines 執行長。

en.title: Edelweiss Air Appoints Edi Wolfensberger as CEO to Succeed Bernd Bauer
en.summary: Swiss leisure airline Edelweiss Air announced on July 31, 2026, that current Eurowings Chief Operating Officer Edi Wolfensberger will take over as its new Chief Executive Officer on October 1, 2026. Wolfensberger will succeed Bernd Bauer, who is stepping down after leading the carrier for 12 years. During Bauer's tenure since taking office in 2014, Edelweiss expanded its route network from around 40 to over 100 destinations and grew its workforce from approximately 500 to almost 1,700 employees. Bauer also served as CEO of Discover Airlines from 2022 to 2025.
body: Swiss leisure airline Edelweiss Air announced on July 31, 2026, that Edi Wolfensberger will assume the role of Chief Executive Officer on October 1, 2026. Wolfensberger, who currently serves as Chief Operating Officer at Eurowings, will succeed Bernd Bauer following Bauer's 12-year tenure leading the carrier.

The 45-year-old Swiss national previously served as Managing Director of Lufthansa Aviation Training Switzerland. Under Bauer's leadership since 2014, Edelweiss expanded its route network from around 40 to over 100 destinations, while its workforce grew from approximately 500 to nearly 1,700 employees. Bauer also served as CEO of Discover Airlines from 2022 to 2025.

zh.title: 空中巴士A321XLR面世挑戰傳統樞紐航網模式
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，空中巴士 A320 家族最新成員 A321XLR 正在直接挑戰傳統的樞紐航網模式，未來可能引發全球航空網路結構的緩慢轉變。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，空中巴士（Airbus）最新加入 A320 家族的機型 A321XLR 正在直接挑戰傳統的樞紐航網模式。該款新客機的發展，未來可能會緩慢地引發全球航空網路的整體轉變。
另一方面，空中巴士正持續推進其民用飛機的產能提升計劃。根據本站於 2026 年 7 月底的歷史紀錄，該公司預計在 2027 年底前，將 A320 家族客機的產量提升至每月 70 至 75 架，以應對全球航空市場的需求。

en.title: Airbus A321XLR Challenges Traditional Hub-and-Spoke Airline Network Model
en.summary: According to aviation news website Simple Flying, the traditional airline hub-and-spoke operational model is being directly challenged by the Airbus A321XLR, the latest narrowbody aircraft to join the popular A320 family. The deployment of this long-range single-aisle aircraft is expected to slowly usher in a global change to airline flight networks, allowing operators to bypass hubs. This structural shift comes as the manufacturer continues to scale up its operations, aiming to achieve a production rate of 70 to 75 A320 family aircraft per month by late 2027.
body: According to a report by aviation news outlet Simple Flying, the traditional hub-and-spoke network model is facing a direct challenge from the Airbus A321XLR, the newest addition to the manufacturer's A320 aircraft family. This development could slowly trigger a global shift in airline network structures in the coming years.

In related developments, Airbus has been working to accelerate its commercial aircraft production. Historical data from late July 2026 indicates that the manufacturer is continuing its production ramp-up, with expectations to reach a monthly production rate of between 70 and 75 aircraft for the A320 family by late 2027.

zh.title: 美國航空重啟84英哩超短程航線 每日規劃三班區域客機
zh.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，美國航空正在重啟一條航程僅84英哩的超短程航線，該航線距離上次營運已有27年歷史。美國航空規劃針對此航線提供每日三班的定期航班服務，並預計採用65座的區域客機進行執飛，重新為該區段提供空中運輸服務。
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年8月3日的報導，美國航空正準備重啟一條僅84英哩長的超短程航線。該條航線上次執行商業飛行任務距今已有27年之久，此次重新投入營運標誌著該短程區段時隔近三十年後再度恢復定期空中客運服務。
在航班營運與排班規劃方面，美國航空預計在該航線上安排每日提供三班的營運班次服務。相關航班計劃採用65座級別的區域客機執飛，重新為該條超短程路線提供高頻率的短程空中運輸能力。

en.title: American Airlines Launches 84-Mile Route Last Flown 27 Years Ago
en.summary: American Airlines is resurrecting an ultra-short 84-mile route that was last flown 27 years ago, according to information published by Simple Flying on August 3, 2026. The air carrier plans to operate three daily flights on the regional route using 65-seater regional jets. The launch marks the resumption of commercial flight operations on this specific route segment after nearly three decades without service, adding an extremely short sector back into the airline's operational network schedule.
body: American Airlines is resurrecting an extremely short regional route measuring only 84 miles in distance, which was last flown 27 years ago. According to report material published by Simple Flying on August 3, 2026, the operational launch brings scheduled commercial air service back to the short sector after nearly three decades of non-operation.

Under the carrier's network schedule, American Airlines plans to serve the 84-mile route with three daily flights. Operational flights on this ultra-short regional sector will be conducted using 65-seater regional jets, providing high-frequency operations for the newly restored route.
